parts.name: Pag-IBIG MP2
parts.rule: Put ₱100,000 in MP2 (tax-free, 5-year term). Dividends are declared once a year (Max uses the last declared rate as the estimate) and added to the balance each 31 Dec (compounded option). Early withdrawal = only half the dividends, so Max never switches.

parts.name: High-yield savings
parts.rule: Keep ₱100,000 in the best savings account that pays its full rate on ₱100,000 (no group/spend conditions, no cap below ₱100,000). Interest is counted daily, paid monthly, 20% tax withheld. Move only if another bank pays at least 0.25% more for 14 days in a row (₱25 transfer fee counted).
parts.creditText: credited every day (it earns interest too)

parts.name: Government bonds (RTB / T-bills)
parts.rule: Buy the best government bond open to retail buyers today (an open RTB, else 1-year T-bills). Interest after 20% tax. Held to maturity — selling early can lose money when rates rise; at maturity the money goes into the best open bond then.

parts.name: Time deposits
parts.rule: Lock ₱100,000 in the best time deposit that accepts ₱100,000 for its term. Interest after 20% tax at maturity. No early break (banks cut the rate); at maturity the money goes into the best time deposit then.
